prompt_en: A polished luxury fashion-editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties in a quiet contemporary hotel corridor, wearing a tailored black blazer, a short pleated skirt, and opaque charcoal thigh-high stockings. She takes one measured step toward the camera while lightly adjusting one blazer cuff. The clearly visible band of bare upper thigh between the short skirt hem and the stocking tops is the central visual attraction. Show her complete head-to-toe outfit at a comfortable editorial distance in an eye-level vertical frame. The corridor's brass seams and floor reflections create a balanced graphic rhythm around her poised silhouette. A tall frosted side window casts feathered amber light across luminous natural skin, matte knit, and crisp tailoring, revealing fine textile texture with restrained specular highlights. Her posture is relaxed and self-possessed, her expression calm, and the complete public-ready ensemble feels refined and contemporary, with realistic anatomy, gentle depth separation, and premium Japanese fashion-editorial polish.
